title: Series and Parallel Circuit Diagnosis

objectives.statement: Calculate expected voltage, current, and equivalent resistance for basic series and parallel circuits.
Compare expected and measured circuit values and identify evidence that is consistent with an open, short, or high-resistance fault.
Apply safe, half-split diagnostic tests to isolate a single introduced fault and document the confirming measurement.

lectures.title: Series and parallel circuit rules and expected values
Complaint verification, expected results, half-split testing, and confirmation

demonstrations.title: Loaded voltage-drop testing across a high-resistance connection
Half-split isolation of an open circuit

labs.title: Build and verify series and parallel circuits
procedure: Calculate expected values from the schematic before energizing.
Build the series circuit and complete a point-to-point inspection.
Measure source, component, and total values and compare them with predictions.
Repeat the process for the parallel circuit.
deliverables: Annotated schematic and expected-versus-measured value table for both circuits.
safety_notes: Apply the measurement controls established in the preceding unit.

labs.title: Single-fault isolation
procedure: Verify the reported symptom without altering the circuit.
Mark expected results at candidate test points on the schematic.
Use half-split tests to narrow the fault location.
Identify the fault as open, short, or high resistance.
Remove the introduced fault and confirm normal operation.
deliverables: Diagnostic worksheet showing symptom, test sequence, readings, conclusion, and post-repair confirmation.
safety_notes: Use only instructor-installed faults on the current-limited trainer.
Stop if observed behavior differs from the trainer fault card.

assessments.title: Circuit prediction check
assessments.description: Learner calculates expected values and explains how one measured result supports or contradicts the prediction.

assessments.title: Fault-isolation practical
assessments.description: Learner safely isolates one introduced fault using an ordered test plan, records evidence, and confirms restored operation.

required_resources: CAT-rated digital multimeter with fused current input
